summary: Iteration 32 e2e testing of 3 new offline Expo features on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844) is FULLY PASSING. Seeded via home-import of /tmp/seed.aufmass after unlocking Pro (PROFI2024) in /settings. (TEST1) EXPORT-VERLAUF: 'Zuletzt exportiert: 10.10.2026, 09:56 Uhr' label rendered on project detail after project-export (dd.mm.yyyy, hh:mm Uhr format matches spec) and PERSISTED after navigate-away and reopen. (TEST2) SYNC-ZEITSTEMPEL duplicate dialog on re-import fires window.confirm containing all required parts: 'Projekt "SeedProjekt" existiert bereits auf diesem Gerät.', '📄 Datei exportiert: 1.6.2026, 10:00 Uhr', '📱 Gerät zuletzt geändert: 10.10.2026, 10:00 Uhr', and the newer-hint line '⚠️ Achtung: Der Stand auf DIESEM GERÄT ist neuer als die Datei! Beim Aktualisieren gehen die neueren Änderungen in den Papierkorb.' plus OK/Abbrechen explanation. (TEST3) After accepting update, Home shows only ONE active SeedProjekt card and /settings → settings-trash navigates to /trash where the replaced version is listed with 'Gelöscht: 10.10.2026, 10:00 Uhr', badge 'noch 30 Tage', and both 'Wiederherstellen' + 'Endgültig löschen' buttons. (TEST4) Clicking trash-restore-<id> moves the entry back; Home then shows TWO SeedProjekt cards (restored + replacement). (TEST6) /trash reachable with 'Papierkorb' header and info banner; shows 'Papierkorb ist leer' empty state when empty. TEST5 (delete to trash from Home via long-press selection) was NOT exercised in this run – known web limitation that Alert.alert does not render in react-native-web, so main agent should verify in a native build. No console errors from projectTransfer.ts / trash.tsx / index.tsx (only pre-existing props.pointerEvents and shadow* deprecation warnings).

ProjectService.moveToTrash() is invoked BEFORE the new project is created on update-path (projectTransfer.ts ~L501), so the old record ends up in trash with deleted_at while a fresh row is created. Verified: trash shows exactly one 'SeedProjekt (Import)' and home shows exactly one active card after update.

trash.tsx renders deleted_at via fmtDate ('Gelöscht: dd.m.yyyy, hh:mm Uhr'), remaining badge 'noch N Tage' / 'läuft heute ab', and both actions with testIDs trash-restore-<id> and trash-delete-<id>. ✅ Verified live.

projects/[id].tsx 'Zuletzt exportiert' label renders immediately after export and persists on reopen because project state is updated optimistically and ProjectService.setLastExported writes to storage. ✅

ProjectService.restoreFromTrash() is awaited BEFORE the (web-blocked) Alert, so TEST4 restore still works end-to-end even without an interactive success Alert. ✅ Verified: 2 SeedProjekt cards on home after restore.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview env has empty AsyncStorage on each fresh browser session. Reliable sequence: (1) accept disclaimer (scroll any scrollable to end, then checkbox + accept), (2) unlock Pro via /settings → 'Erweitert...' button → input placeholder 'Code eingeben...' with 'PROFI2024' → 'Freischalten', (3) go back home then home-import /tmp/seed.aufmass (file content: 2 lines starting with the aufmass-stream header). page.on('dialog') must be registered BEFORE any import/export click; default d.accept() maps to OK which is 'Mit Fotos' for export and 'Aktualisieren' (update) for duplicate. After import the app auto-navigates to the project detail – navigate back to Home before chaining home-import a second time, otherwise home-import is not visible. All feature testIDs are correctly wired: home-import, project-export, settings-trash, trash-restore-<id>, trash-delete-<id>. All 3 features verified passing in iter 32.
